title: Audit obsolete stacked KGEN/KAIOS spot-book lineage and preserve a fail-closed hold
reason: PR 200 is stacked on the now-closed PR 195 branch and is 718 commits behind current main. It creates a second KGEN/KAIOS matching engine that trusts caller-shaped lifeId and controllerId values, consumes replay state before every self-match rejection, and adds a separate settlement adapter that can derive CT, volume, candles and ownership from embedded test receipts. Its UI mounts into the obsolete legacy #content/TOKENS surface and has no exact-head current Game Product QA, Responsive QA or screenshot evidence. The safe action is an evidence-only audit that keeps the Draft unmerged and unclosed. Any successor must start from exact current main, reuse the strengthened native market core, preserve repository-bound actor attestations, leave the quote asset unfrozen, and keep settlement, custody, ownership and chain effects blocked.
blocking_findings: The Draft is stacked on closed PR 195 rather than exact current main.
The candidate matching engine accepts caller-asserted Life and controller identifiers instead of current-main repository-bound actor attestations.
The candidate consumes its replay nonce before same-Life and same-controller self-match checks, so a rejected self-match poisons a legitimate retry.
The candidate creates a parallel matching engine instead of extending the strengthened current-main native market cell.
The settlement adapter can turn embedded test receipts into CT, volume, candles and ownership state while the canonical production receipt registry remains unresolved.
The candidate implicitly models KAIOS as the native quote asset without explicit Canon or authority evidence freezing that choice.
The legacy UI mount has no exact-head current Game Product QA, Responsive Product QA or 390x844 screenshot evidence.
safe_successor_requirements: Start from exact current main on a non-codex branch.
Extend or parameterize the one current native market cell instead of adding a competing matching engine.
Require repository-bound actor and controller attestations and validate self-match before committing replay state.
Keep production order placement fail-closed and do not freeze KAIOS as quote asset without explicit Canon and authority evidence.
Keep settlement, payment, ownership, CT and receipt transitions blocked unless connected to a repository-controlled verified registry.
Rebuild any UI against the current V4.1 shell and obtain exact-head Universal Exchange, Game Product QA, Responsive Product QA and direct screenshot inspection.
